description: Rock Spring, GA.— Andrew Underwood has officially signed his pledge to co-sponsor and vote for the U.S. Term Limits Amendment of three two-year House terms and two six-year Senate terms. He joins a small list of candidates in this election that are fully committed to keeping Congress accountable. U.S. Term Limits is a nonpartisan non-profit advocating
